spec.description: Breakout module with a single 5 mm red LED and a series current-limiting resistor. Drive the S pin high to light the LED.
warnings: The middle '+' pin is not connected on most 3-pin LED modules; leave it floating.
Do not remove the series resistor: the LED would draw more than the 12 mA the ESP32 GPIO can source.

pins.note: LED signal; HIGH turns the LED on. Moved from GPIO35 because GPIO35 is input-only on the ESP32 and cannot drive a load.

corrections.reason: GPIO35 is input-only on the ESP32; it cannot drive "S" as an output signal. Move it to a general-purpose GPIO such as 25, 26, 27, 32 or 33.

originalViolations.message: GPIO35 is input-only on the ESP32; it cannot drive "S" as an output signal. Move it to a general-purpose GPIO such as 25, 26, 27, 32 or 33.
